title: Cale88 classified as MSME --DTI witness
summary: Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared business interest of Vice President Sara Duterte"s husband Manases Carpio, is classified as a Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME), a defense witness said Friday.

blocks.text: Cale88 Foods Corporation which is being linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband Manases Carpio, is classified as a Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME), a defense witness said Friday.

Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group made the testimony during Day 45 of the impeachment trial of Vice President Duterte.
“Ito po (Cale88) ay MSME po kasi siya dahil po dung po sa project cost niya, below 15 million pesos,” Rodolfo, who also serves as the Managing Head of the Board of Investments, said.
(Cale88 is MSME because the project cost is below P15 million.)
Rodolfo then said Cale88 applied for a Certificate of Registration of an Export Enterprise before the BOI Extension in Davao and secured subsequent approval from the same office.

“We streamlined the BOI system in 2016 for MSMEs under a Board Resolution, meaning the evaluation and approval [of a business] is now delegated function. This means that is the business is in Luzon, it would be under the Executive Director of Industry Development Service. Outside Luzon, it will depend on the jurisdiction of BOI Extension Office. Para dito po [sa Cale88], BOI Extension Office sa Davao ‘yung nag evaluate at nag approve,” Rodolfo pointed out.
(It is the BOI Davao office which evaluated and approved its application.)

“Dahil po sa na-register po siya, ina-assume ko lang po na wala po nakuhang objection ‘yung Davao office po natin [sa Cale88 application for Certificate of Registration of an Export Enterprise]. Wala po akong nakita dun sa kanilang evaluation report na merong nag-object,” he added.
(Since it was registered, I assume that nobody objected to its application, and that our Davao office did not find any things objectionable to its application based on the evaluation report.)
Rodolfo also said that as an MSME, Cale88 is not required to publish Certificate of Registration of an Export Enterprise in newspaper for general circulation.

“This requirement does not apply to Cale88 being an MSME. What we do is we post the notice [of its Certificate of Registration of an Export Enterprise] on our BOI website kasi medyo mahal rin po mag-publish sa newspaper of general circulation,” Rodolfo said.

Defense team lawyer Justin Gular said Rodolfo’s testimony disputes the findings of prosecution witness and financial forensic expert Alex Cabrera who earlier testified that Cale88 is not a real functioning business based on Cabrera’s analysis of the financial records of the Vice President and her husband.

“The exact term, Your Honor, if I may, by the supposed forensic expert is that Cale88 is allegedly an implausible business model. And of course, we seek to dispute, among other things, that monies were received by Mans Carpio from this corporation,” Gular said.

Cabrera, an accountant-lawyer, earlier testified that the Vice President and her husband have unexplained wealth worth P817 million to P1.5 billion due to non-declaration of their assets in their joint Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN), including income from Cale88 Foods Corporation.

Defense witness and AML Consulting PH head, Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente, testified a day ago that there were red flags in Cale88 Foods Corporation operations given that the firm only has two employees, received P319 million remittances from China and recorded 757 covered transactions and suspicious transactions worth P1.2 billion.
Dela Fuente, however, said such red flags are not automatically illegal. —VAL, GMA News
